title: Material Synthesis Preparation with CSV Input
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Create CSV files for tube racks
steps.instruction: Generate CSV files to define the source and destination tube racks. The protocol can handle up to four 24‑tube custom racks containing unique volumes of reagents 1‑18 sourced from a 15 mL tube rack and a 50 mL tube rack. Each destination‑rack CSV must contain the header: Rack, Well, Label, DEAEMA (mL), AEMAm (mL), DIPAEMA (mL), DMAEMA (mL), MPC (mL), PEGMA500 (mL), HEMA (mL), PEGMA300 (mL), PEGMA950 (mL), GlyMA (mL), PHPMA (mL), Initiator (mL), CTA (mL), Initiator 2 (mL), CTA 2 (mL), Solv (mL), Solv2, Solv3. Column names may vary but the number of columns must remain the same. Create an “initial volumes” CSV with the header: Slot (2 or 5), Tube Position (A1, A2, etc.), Initial Volume (mL). This file must contain 18 data rows (15 rows for the 15‑tube rack and 3 rows for the 50 mL rack).

steps.title: Transfer liquid to first destination well
steps.instruction: Perform a single‑tip liquid transfer from the source tube (A1, deck slot 2) to the first destination well (A1, deck slot 3).

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh pipette tip.
Aspirate from A1 of the source tube rack at deck slot 2, positioning the tip so it does not penetrate the liquid deeper than 75 % of the tip length.
Raise the pipette to the top of the source tube at a speed of 10 mm/s and pause for 5 s.
Touch the tip at a vertical offset of –1 mm from the top of the tube.
Move to well A1 of the custom destination rack at deck slot 3.
Dispense the liquid at the top of the destination tube.
Delay for 5 s, then blow out at a flow rate of 5 µL/s.

steps.title: Transfer to remaining destination wells
steps.instruction: Repeat the substeps above over wells A2 through D6 using the array of volumes and flow rates specified for each well, always drawing liquid from the same source location A1.

steps.title: Repeat for each source tube
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire transfer sequence (pick‑up tip through drop tip, including the array repeat) for every source tube in the Falcon tube racks located at deck slots 2 and 5.

steps.title: Mix destination vials
steps.instruction: For each destination vial, mix by aspirating and dispensing 200 µL of liquid three consecutive times.

steps.title: Repeat for all destination racks
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 2 through 5 for all destination vial racks positioned at deck slots 7, 8, and 9.
